notes.title: News Update + New Game Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]📢 Dev Update: A Message to Tomb Explorer Fans + New Game Announcement[/b]

Hey Tomb Explorer fans —
It’s been a couple months since our last update. [b]After more than 8 months of continuous updates, polish, and new content[/b], we can confidently say that Tomb Explorer VR is a completely different game than it was at launch. Many of you have noticed too — as reflected in reviews — It now stands as a full release-quality experience—aside from some ongoing development of the in-game save system, as requested by the community post launch."

But let’s talk about the reality behind the scenes.

🎯 [b]The State of Early Access & PCVR[/b]

Early Access was once about supporting cool ideas in development, but now it’s treated as a guarantee of polished, AAA-quality games — even from tiny indie teams. These expectations are not sustainable, especially for PCVR developers. Gamers are just not investing anymore to help build something.

And here’s the hard truth:
[b]Tomb Explorer VR makes almost no money.[/b]

We’re just two indie devs, self-funded, building games out of love for PCVR. Despite almost no algorithmic or influencer support (unless you're sponsored), we’ve delivered:

    🔹 15+ PC quality maps

    🔹 AAA visuals & new VR physics tech

    🔹 Various Weapons + Tools [ Bows / Pistols / Bull Whips / Fire Torches ]

    🔹 Full soundtrack

    🔹 Tons of enemies, traps & puzzles

    🔹 Two bosses

    🔹 A complete story campaign with cinematic dialogue maps

[b]That’s far more than most Early Access VR titles, which often launch with one, two or three levels max, government funded studios with multiple team members and then iterate post-success. We’re old-school — we build first, then release. That was our flaw. [/b]

💡 [b]What’s Next?[/b]
We’re adapting. To survive, we’ve split efforts:

👷‍♂️ One of us is still working on Tomb Explorer VR updates - [ gradual integration of per level in-game save system + new content ]
🎮 The other has built something new: The Descent VR

[b]And don’t worry — Tomb Explorer VR is NOT abandoned.[/b]
In fact, we’ve got a big update and sale coming this May!
[b]We’ve been on Steam for over five years, and every game we’ve released has gotten long-term support — more than we can say for some bigger studios.[/b]

[b]⚠️ A Quick But Important Note:[/b]

Lately, we’ve seen suspicious negative reviews — new accounts with single reviews, often arriving during sales using cheap currency conversions to make one off reviews, likely linked to bad actors who’ve previously harassed our brand over the years in reviews, forums, and discord.

It’s a known tactic in the already brutal PCVR market, where Steam’s algorithm gives little support to small indie VR devs building EA Games.

[b]If you’ve enjoyed the game, please consider leaving a review. It helps fight back and makes a real difference for us.[/b]

[h3][b]🔦 Now Announcing: The Descent VR[/b][/h3]

Built solo by one of us (with some help from the other), The Descent VR is a tighter, darker horror adventure. It’s much smaller than Tomb Explorer, but packed with atmosphere, tension, and mystery along with the high quality you expect from our games.

[previewyoutube=1HDahrkLS70;full][/previewyoutube]

🎮 Support us and support PCVR:
👉 Wishlist or grab it on Steam

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2972480/THE_DESCENT_VR/

Thanks for standing with us.
We may be small — but we’re not going anywhere.

– Celeritas Games

notes.title: Tomb Explorer VR EA News Update! *WARNING SPOILERS*
notes.notes:
Hello, Explorers! First off we would like to apologize to everyone for significant delays... There's a saying in game development, that 10% is game development and 90% is fixing Bugs and Polish! This is partially the cause for delays but that would not be the entire story.
 
The truth is we have added additional content to ' fill in ' what was deemed to be missing after fixing the majority of bugs, this work has revealed a much higher quality experience, which in turn revealed "weaker spots". 

For this reason we have added much more to the game to make it the complete experience we can be confident with. I will explain below!

[h3][b]EARLY ACCESS EXPECTATIONS[/b][/h3]

[b]PREVIOUS EARLY ACCESS LAUNCH EXPECTATIONS[/b]
“The Early Access version of the game currently includes the [b]core game play mechanics[/b] and features [b]six completed levels[/b] set in three unique location environments. Players can expect over four hours of game play duration in the current version.”

[h3][url=]*SPOILERS*[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Tomb Explorer VR Release Delayed.
notes.notes:
Hello, Explorers! Today, we announce a delay for the release of TombVR. We are working hard on delivering the Early Access version; however, to us, this still means providing a solid gaming experience worthy of Full Access. Due to scheduling issues behind the scenes, we have mismanaged our time frames and require more time for testing and addressing feedback issues. This will ensure the highest quality product during the Early Access phase!

[b]RELEASE DELAY[/b]: The release date will be pushed back to [b]ETA FEBRUARY![/b] The official date will be sorted out ASAP! We apologize for any inconvenience and unmet expectations. We continue to work hard to provide the BEST ADVENTURE EXPERIENCE IN VR!

[b]INDIEGOGO SUPPORTERS PRE-RELEASE VERSION[/b]: As promised for your support, you will be receiving a pre-release copy under Non-Disclosure Agreements shortly. This ensures that supporters are rewarded first, and we receive extra feedback to further polish the game. We will contact those relevant with details.

[b]VR SOCIAL MEDIA AWARENESS[/b]: Many VR influencers and websites have still not covered this game, which is concerning for indie developers. The VR market is small, while the quality and content we have put into Tomb Explorer VR should easily stand out!

[b]We ask our followers and fans[/b] to let influencers and VR websites know to cover Tomb Explorer with [b]a simple email and/or comment on their VR platforms.[/b] It only takes a few minutes and should make a huge difference.

[b]Please follow us and Wish-list the game and prepare for the adventure of a life time in VR![/b]
